concepts.gloss_en: The lust of adultery/illicit sexual desire (the desire itself, as a base concept)

members.note: the lust itself; base construct noun

concepts.gloss_en: The breaking/subduing of the lust of adultery (an act performed upon the lust, not the lust itself)

members.note: construct head שבירה (breaking) — action about the lust, not the lust (rule 4)

concepts.gloss_en: The rectification of the lust of adultery (act of tikkun; distinct construct head from 'breaking')

members.note: construct head תקון (rectification) — different head than שבירה; separate action-concept (rule 4)

concepts.gloss_en: The lust of adultery that has been nullified (the lust in its nullified state/event)

members.note: relative clause שנתבטל denotes a state/event of nullification about the lust; kept separate per under-merge and rule 4

notes: All four kept separate: the base desire (תאות נאוף) vs. distinct acts upon it — שבירה (breaking) and תקון (rectification) have different construct heads (rule 4), and 'שנתבטל' names a nullified state/event of the desire. Note that the proof quotes for both שבירת and תקון forms derive from the same passage (LM2:5 'תקון המחין via שבירת תאות נאוף'), but the differing heads keep them distinct.
